title: American Gods
author: Neil Gaiman
summary: A man released from prison after his wife's sudden death takes a job as bodyguard to a charming stranger who knows too much. As they cross the United States, he finds that old gods brought by immigrants are preparing for war with new ones.
readIf: you like a strange, atmospheric road trip through folklore and modern America.
skipIf: you want a tight, fast plot, as it wanders through many side stories and ends up slow-burning.

pairings.reason: Same author, a shorter and more whimsical fantasy about a hidden world just beneath a real city.
A comic take on divine and demonic forces, if you want the same ideas with more laughs.
A very different book that also cares deeply about how myth and human love shape each other.
